name: dread_presence_swamp_enters_draw_and_lose_1
notes: Printed: 'Whenever a Swamp you control enters, choose one - You draw a card and you lose 1 life; or This creature deals 2 damage to any target and you gain 2 life.' P0 plays a Swamp with Dread Presence out and picks the first mode: P0 draws one card (hand 1 -> 0 after the land drop -> 1) and goes to 19 life. Nothing is damaged.
